_comment: Three lists, and a name belongs to exactly one of them. "jobs" must show a healthy run inside the threshold -- these are the ones a dead scheduler would silently take with it. "on_demand" logs like everything else but is never late, because it runs when someone asks. "not_invoked" is not called by any chain at all, and the value says why -- a module, or a tool that answers a question rather than reaching a verdict. A name in two of them stops the tool with exit 2. A name in none is reported, never guessed at. Verify with: python check_freshness.py --vault <VaultRoot>

on_demand.check_duplicates: runs in the verification chain and by hand, never on a schedule
on_demand.write_command: runs once during setup, and again only if the command file is gone
on_demand.check_freshness: this tool itself -- logged, never watched: an age limit on the watcher is a regress

not_invoked.vault_paths: a module, not a command -- it has no main(), the other tools import it
not_invoked._testkit: a module, imported by the suites only
not_invoked.count_tokens: answers a question on request and reaches no verdict: it reports a size, so it has no pass, no fail and nothing a chain could act on
